title: Headquarters Department of the Ohio to Brig. Gen. Ammen, Knoxville, 29 Sept 1864 (Ball State DMR LSTACivWar 2072): Union route cipher reconstructed and read, 85 of 90 words sure

documents.shelfmark: Henry County Historical Society (New Castle, Ind.), Ammen Civil War Collection; Ball State University DMR, LSTACivWar, compound object 2072 (page 2070 = HCHS_L_18640929_01)
documents.route: Headquarters Department of the Ohio (G. M. Bascom, for Schofield) -> Brig. Gen. Ammen, Knoxville

plaintext.source: The War of the Rebellion, Official Records, series I, vol. XXXIX, part 2, p. 524

transcription.source: Ball State DMR image (1025 px wide, NoC-US 1.0)
transcription.notes: one AI transcriber; one word per token, frozen before the calculation

system.summary: Union (Stager family) route cipher: plain words in two grids of 6 columns, sent column 6 up, 1 down, 5 up, 2 down, 4 up, 3 down; null words in each column; code words for proper names.

prior_solution.where: Clear text printed in the Official Records, series I, vol. XXXIX, part 2, p. 524. Daniel Bourdeau's leads 1432 / 2097 list the sheet as a coded letter to Ammen without a reading.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout set the rules (protocol hashed before the calculation). An AI agent transcribed, found the route and read; no human palaeographer checked.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agent run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Two images downloaded from the Ball State repository; date corrected from 1862 to 29 Sept 1864 from the sheet.
Body transcribed word by word (107 tokens), hashed before the calculation.
Clear text found printed in the Official Records, series I, vol. XXXIX, part 2, p. 524.
Route of the Union cipher family reconstructed: 2 grids of 6 columns, route 6 up, 1 down, 5 up, 2 down, 4 up, 3 down; nulls and code words identified.
Descriptive bigram measure 0.455 against 0.250 for 200 control routes; declared non-decisive (blocks cut with the reconstruction).
Read: 85 of 90 words sure, 1 probable (was = forces), 3 code words restored from the printed text, 1 unresolved (rig).

outcome.method: key recovered based on plaintext from external sources
outcome.method_basis: The route was rebuilt from the sheet with the clear text printed in the Official Records at hand (found before the attempt).

validation.notes: Standard character test declared not applicable; descriptive measure 0.455 vs 0.250 with a declared bias.

outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.md: 90 cipher words of the body; strict count 85 sure (0.944); with 1 probable 0.956; with 3 restored code words 0.989; 1 unresolved

credits.note: Official Records, series I, vol. XXXIX, part 2, p. 524: the clear text
transcription, route and code words rebuilt, reading with the sheet's date corrected to 1864

gaps.item: rig before W. T. Sherman unresolved
one AI transcriber; no human check

texts.label: Knoxville, 29 Sept 1864, dispatch in cypher to Brig. Gen. Ammen
texts.summary: Sherman's order of 28 Sept recalls Burbridge to Nashville; Schofield's headquarters ask Ammen to forward it, acknowledge receipt and report, adding that Burbridge may not have this cypher.

reading_review.note: read as sentences; clear text printed in the Official Records; one word unresolved

outcome.notes: No image is reproduced (NoC-US 1.0, watermark, commercial use needs HCHS permission). The leads 1432 and 2097 of the catalogue are one object; their date 1862 should read 1864. Daniel's vetting of lead 1432 (4 Nov 2026) already gives the 1864 date and the Official Records page; lead 2097 is closed there as its duplicate.
